injuries.name: Florian Xhekaj
injuries.note: Oliver Kapanen (lower body) was activated from injured reserve in a corresponding move. Xhekaj will sit out his fourth straight game against Buffalo on Saturday. The Canadiens announced Friday that Xhekaj is expected to miss another two weeks.

injuries.name: Ivan Demidov
injuries.note: Demidov's placement on injured reserve is simply procedural after the Canadiens announced Tuesday that he'll be sidelined for 2-4 weeks due to a lower-body injury. The 20-year-old appeared in all 82 regular-season games for Montreal last year and recorded 19 goals, 43 assists, 34 PIM, 28 hits and 26 blocked shots while averaging 15:30 of ice time.

injuries.name: Bowen Byram
injuries.note: Upper-body: The Blackhawks said on Thursday (Oct. 22) that Byram is still considered day-to-day but is trending towards returning.
